verdict.rationale: Dark mode and night light are a fair customization question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents either feature. The documented customization topics cover only changing the default terminal and login applications, and the accessibility 'Adjust the contrast' entry is a different control from dark mode or night light, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can switch to dark mode or enable a night light to reduce eye strain
